toolchain_lesson: IMPORTANT: sandbox rustc/cargo toolchain can silently fall behind CI's `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable` pin between runs. Before trusting any local `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` result as authoritative evidence about CI health, verify rustc --version matches CI's pinned version (check the doc URL embedded in clippy's own error output, e.g. /rust-1.99.0/). Confirmed 1.99.0 this run (2026-10-11) without needing rustup update - matches CI pin, consistent with the last several runs.
